messages:
julie: hey @support, our web app is throwing JSONDecodeError when parsing responses from /v1/generate?mode=json. started after the 09:00 deploy. sample raw model output attached.

julie: ```
{"id": 123, "status": "ok", "payload": {"items": ["a", "b", "c"]},
unexpected trailing text: "note: processed 3 items"}
```

marie: thanks — can you paste the request_id or trace id? also which model + temp?

julie: request_id=rid_0a9f2c trace: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/rid_0a9f2c model=redwood-v2-medium temperature=0.9 route=/v1/generate?mode=json

anil: likely structured-output parse failure — looks like model emitted extra freeform text after JSON. high temp can cause this. do we have schema_version pinned? any recent rollout that changed schema expectations?

julie: schema_version=2, we recently switched prompt template to include "notes" field optional. This started immediately after that change.

anil: possible schema drift + sampling noise. quick repro: run with temperature=0.0 and deterministic sampling. if output is valid there, it's probabilistic. Also enable strict validation on server side for now to convert errors into structured failures (not 5xx).

ops-oncall: I've enabled structured_output.strict=true for this tenant and set fallback_policy=return_error to stop invalid JSON from hitting prod. Will monitor.

sre-bot: [auto] trace created: https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/rid_0a9f2c/spans; span=span_993fc

marie: for observability, we should add metrics: structured_output.parse_error_count, parse_error_by_model, parse_error_by-route, parse_error_by-schema_version. add a dashboard tile and an alert if error_rate > 0.5% over 5m for a route.

anil: agree. Also add sampled_raw_output retention: store 10 error samples per tenant per hour (redacted). implement PII redaction before storing. recommend storing hash of request+prompt and link to trace instead of full prompt.

marie: can you also add a quick debug flag we can flip per-tenant to capture token-level logits and prefix tokens? We'll limit to 30m and auto-redact.

anil: yes — endpoint accepts X-Redwood-Debug: capture_tokens=true; expires=30m. curl example:

anil: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "X-Redwood-Debug: capture_tokens=true;expires=30m" \
 -d '{"input": "...", "mode":"json"}' \
 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

julie: ok turning debug on for 30m now.

marie: created internal ticket INF-2345 and assigned to eng-runtime. will follow up in this thread with dashboard link and escalation notes.

anil: short-term mitigation: pin model to redwood-v2-medium@rev-20241112 or lower temp; long-term: add model output formatter step that enforces JSON and wraps freeform text in separate field.

julie: thanks. I'll monitor and report if errors persist. :thumbsup:
